stories.title: EU Grocers Pay a Steep Price for Unpatched Fridge Firmware

stories.title: Le Pen finds few allies in Brussels for her EU budget 'showdown'
stories.summary: The far-right presidential candidate argued for cutting France's financial contribution to the European Union, but her usual partners stopped short of endorsing her demands.

stories.title: French MPs reject bid to lower cap on pensioners' tax break
stories.summary: The government had submitted a measure to trim the cap on a 10% tax break for pensioners, hoping to bring in €1.4 billion for the public budget amid concern about France's debt. Lawmakers rejected the measure by 116 votes to 30.

entries.title: The leak didn't move the date
entries.body: Rockstar ran its Netflix Extended Look on 27 August as planned, and 19 November still stands. Take-Two, meanwhile, has served DMCA subpoenas on Microsoft, Discord, X and Google chasing the handle CyberLeek.
